title: Campaigns
subtitle: Bringing back someone who already knows you costs less than finding someone new. Here are the usual lists, already worked out, and what it would cost to message them.

inactive.name: Haven't come back
inactive.hint: No visit in {days} days. Biggest spenders first.

loyaltyReward.name: Earned their reward
loyaltyReward.hint: They hit the visit count and haven't claimed it.

noShow.name: Missed several times
noShow.hint: {count} no-shows or more. Decide if you want a deposit.

list.empty: Nobody is on this list right now. That's good news.
list.batchNote: Sent in batches of {max}. Pick who goes in this one.
list.trimmed: We picked the first {max}: that's the most per batch.

cost.heading: What this will cost
cost.marketing: Marketing category: about 4x the price of a reminder, and it needs the client's consent.
cost.whoPays: Meta charges this to your WhatsApp account, not us.
cost.none: Pick someone to see the cost.

quota.label: Messages in your plan
quota.near: You're at {pct}% of your message allowance.
quota.exhausted: You've used your whole message allowance.
quota.over: This batch ({count}) doesn't fit in what's left ({remaining}). We'll send what fits.

promo.label: Your offer
promo.help: This is the only part you write: the greeting and the shop name are already in the approved template.
promo.tokenHelp: They're swapped for each client's own details. If a client doesn't have one, the tag just disappears.
promo.previewNobody: This is how the message reads
promo.placeholder: Write the offer you want to bring them back with.

send.confirmLead: You're about to message {count} clients. This costs your WhatsApp account:
send.confirmCheck: I understand this is a marketing message and my clients opted in.
send.doneWithFailed: {sent} messages went out. {failed} couldn't be sent.
send.costChanged: The list changed since you saw the cost. Check it again before sending.
send.quotaStopped: Sending stopped: your plan's message allowance ran out.
send.needsTemplate: Meta still has to approve the {name} template. Turn it on in the WhatsApp screen before sending campaigns.
send.templatePending: The {name} template is under review by Meta. You can send as soon as it's approved.
send.noPermission: You don't have permission to send WhatsApp messages.

templates.title: Your wording
templates.lead: One text per campaign. It's saved to your shop and used every time you send that list.
templates.cooldownHelp: Nobody gets two campaigns back to back before that many days, even if they show up on several lists.
templates.sqlPending: Can't save yet: sql/barber_campanas.sql hasn't been applied. Meanwhile the suggested wording is used and you can still send campaigns.

results.title: What happened with what you sent
results.lead: Last {days} days. The column that matters is the last one: how many came back after getting your message.
results.empty: You haven't sent any campaigns yet.
results.returnedHelp: Came back = had a visit after getting the message.

optouts.title: Opt-outs
optouts.lead: Anyone who asked not to be messaged stays off every send list. Always. You can undo it here if it was a mistake.

errors.noPlan: Campaigns are on the Advanced and Professional plans.
errors.noPermission: You don't have permission to see this screen.
errors.noWhatsapp: Connect your WhatsApp before sending campaigns.
